<function name="OnRightClick" parent="MatSelect" type="panelhook">
	<description>Called when the player right clicks a material.

By default, this opens a menu that lets the player copy the material path.
</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<added>2024.09.02</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="pnl" type="Panel">The <page>DImageButton</page> that was clicked.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
